4694-6258-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2393-4279-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

277-1021-5411-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

719-5147-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5147-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

215-6791-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-6791-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-6633-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4112-4375-8095.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

654-4365-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

413-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1417-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4091-6478-7791.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5570-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-5776-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.

1648-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1648-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1651-4639-4702-4891.description:
Turn Atsushi into an artifact using Unctus.
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature That Triggers on Being Tapped

549-1651-5640--135.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and the creature with a tap trigger, targeting the creature.
Ertha Jo and the creature trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger.
Resolve the Ertha Jo trigger, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and the creature tapped in step 1.
Repeat.

1495-4613-6661.description:
Activate Minwu by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Minwu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

567-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
567-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Soul's Attendant indestructible.
567-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

397-4716-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-4716-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2178-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2034-2178-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

969-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

2327-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
2327-3489-3542.description:
Declare Moon-Circuit Hacker as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

413-1734-3175.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1082-3087-5284.description:
Cast Balthor by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Balthor enters the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability, creating a token copy of Balthor.
Put the nontoken Balthor into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate the token Balthor by paying {B}{B}{B} and exiling it, returning all black and red creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Balthor and Blood Vassal enter the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability twice.
Resolve the first Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Blood Vassal.
Activate the token Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the second Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Balthor.
Repeat from step 3.
